scope: Read all 24 passages, overviews, periods, endings and identity notes. Five selected root checks across 12 works.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct Canadian Institute of Ukrainian Studies entry confirms broad upper-river extent, Izborsk/Polotsk/Smolensk context and later Rus' incorporation.
Direct institute entry confirms Desna and eastern river areas, tribute account under 884 and last chronicle mention after 1024.
Direct Izborsk museum exhibition confirms early settlement tools and two African-minted dirhams dated 792/3, with European circulation dated 800-825.
Direct excavator's Ukrainian academy entry confirms more than seven hectares, over 60 dwellings, about 250 metal objects, two hoards and mixed Slavic/Turkic interpretation.
Indexed National Library of Russia original gives кривичехъ and на северех in the same 859 account. Public copy explicitly labels the 1377 manuscript as later witness.

limits: Seven other works were not independently reopened; precise agent locators remain in the handoff. National Library page failed direct fetch but indexed institutional original shows both phrases. This is bounded review, not full historical certification.
